verdict.rationale: Render's docs list a dedicated 'Custom domains' section, and the platform claims free TLS certificates for every domain, including wildcards. Together these indicate first-party support for attaching custom domains to deployed services. missing for 10: detailed documentation of the domain attachment workflow (DNS setup, verification, per-service configuration), CLI/API management of domains, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can attach custom domains to my deployed services

citations.quote: Free TLS certificates for every domain, including wildcards.
